facts.fact: MTN Nigeria launched the $235 million Dabengwa Sifiso Data Centre in Lagos in July 2025, with cloud infrastructure the company claims rivals Amazon, Microsoft and Google offerings.
The MTN Dabengwa Sifiso Data Centre in Lagos, launched July 2025, is stated to be the largest Tier III facility in West Africa (no certifier named).
